article.title: Holder deriving title from holder in due course.
article.content:
53Holder deriving title from holder in due course.

Section 53  ·  Chapter IV  ·  page 16 of the Act
A holder of a negotiable instrument who derives title from a holder in due course has the rights thereon of that holder in due course.
